$comment: 听力训练营 L15（P-L2）。脚本 100% 原创；阶段二 · Part 4 主旨三选一（5 段电话留言，相似话题干扰：都是留言，各自要点不同）+ Part 2 笔记填空（一段电话留言 5 空：姓名拼读 D-A-W-S-O-N、地名、时间、价格、时间）。词汇 ≥95% 落在 KET A2 词表，超出的词进 warmup。语速 0.9x。
title: Phone Messages
intro: 五条电话留言，每条只问「留言的人想说什么」；再听一条完整留言，记下打电话的人（要拼名字）、地点、时间和要带的钱。

sections.intro: 听一条电话留言，选出留言的人想说什么。

script.text: Hello, this is a message for Ben from the dentist. Your visit was on Tuesday at four, but the dentist is away that day.
So we have moved it to Thursday at four, same time, same place. Please call us if that is a problem.

questions.q: What is the woman telling Ben?
options: His visit is on a different day.
His visit is in a different place.
questions.explain: moved it to Thursday / same time, same place——只有日期变了。地点没变，价格没提。

sections.intro: 听一条电话留言，选出留言的人想说什么。

script.text: Hi Lucy, it's Amy. I'm really sorry, but I can't come to the cinema tonight. I've got a bad cold and Mum says I must stay in bed.
Go with your sister, and tell me about the film tomorrow. Bye!

options: She can't go to the cinema.
She will be late for the cinema.
questions.explain: I can't come to the cinema tonight + a bad cold——她来不了。不是迟到，电影也没变。

sections.intro: 听一条电话留言，选出留言的人想说什么。

script.text: Alex, it's Mum. I'm still at work, so can you go to the shop on your way home and get some bread and milk?
There's money on the kitchen table. I'll cook dinner when I get back at six. Thanks, love.

questions.q: What does Mum want Alex to do?
questions.explain: go to the shop … get some bread and milk——让他买东西。做饭是妈妈自己回来做（I'll cook），没让他去单位等。

sections.intro: 听一条电话留言，选出留言的人想说什么。

script.text: Hello, this is Mr Hall from school with a message for Kate's parents. Kate has a letter about the swimming lessons in her bag.
Please sign it and send it back with Kate tomorrow. Without it, she can't swim on Friday. Thank you.

questions.q: What is the teacher asking Kate's parents to do?
questions.explain: please sign it and send it back——要家长签字。没说买泳帽，也没请家长来学校。

sections.intro: 听一条电话留言，选出留言的人想说什么。

script.text: Good afternoon, this is the bike shop. Harry's bike is ready now, the new wheel is on and it rides really well.
You can collect it any time before six today, or tomorrow morning. It's twenty-five pounds, as we said.

questions.q: What is the man telling Harry?
options: His bike is ready to collect.
His bike needs a new wheel.
questions.explain: Harry's bike is ready now / you can collect it——车修好了来取。新轮子已经装上（the new wheel is on），不是还需要换。

sections.intro: 听一条完整的电话留言，把笔记补全。打电话的人会拼出自己的名字。

script.text: Hello, this is a message for Ben. It's Mrs Dawson here, Harry's mum. That's D-A-W-S-O-N.
Harry would like you to come swimming with us on Saturday. We're going to the new pool on Bridge Road, not the old one on Park Road.
We'll meet you outside the pool at quarter past two. The pool opens at two, but it's always busy then.
It costs three pounds for children, so bring three pounds, and a towel. We have another swimming hat if you need one.
Can you call me back before six o'clock this evening to say yes or no? After six we're going out.
Thanks, Ben. Hope to see you on Saturday. Bye!

questions.explain: It's Mrs Dawson here … That's D-A-W-S-O-N，听拼读写名字。
the new pool on Bridge Road, not the old one on Park Road。Park Road 被 not 否定。
meet you outside the pool at quarter past two = 2:15。two 是开门时间。
it costs three pounds for children, so bring three pounds = 3，儿童票三镑。
call me back before six o'clock = 6，六点以后他们要出门。
